name: Depth relighting
author: Gnomalab Estudio
description: Lights the scene with a directional light computed from the relief of the depth map: it brings out volume, highlights and shadows without touching the original photo. It uses no model, only the photo's depth map.

params.name: strength
params.label: Strength
params.tooltip: How strong the new light looks: 0 = the image as it is, 1 = fully relit.

params.name: azimuth
params.label: Direction
params.tooltip: Where the light comes from, in degrees around the image: 0 = from above, 90 = from the right, 180 = from below, 270 = from the left.

params.name: elevation
params.label: Height
params.tooltip: Height of the light: 90 = straight at the camera (flat light), low values = raking light with long shadows.

params.name: relief
params.label: Relief
params.tooltip: How much the depth map sticks out: more relief = stronger highlights and shadows.

params.name: warmth
params.label: Warmth
params.tooltip: Tints the lit areas: positive = warm (orange) light, negative = cold (blue) light.
